M77 Description This pedal features a classic overdrive circuit that's been upgraded with a 100HZ control and a Bump switch for improved performance and versatility.   This pedal can be powered by a 9-volt battery, a Dunlop ECB003 9-volt adapter, or the DC Brick™, Iso-Brick™, and Mini Iso-Brick™ power supplies (not included).   Warranty Information The Long Story The Custom Badass Modified O.D. features a classic overdrive circuit with modern modifications for improved performance and versatility. For added flexibility, we've added a 100HZ cut and boost control that allows for a more focused EQ when cut, or a beefier tone when boosted. The Bump switch engages an alternate EQ voicing that boosts the lows and mids. Put it in front of the '78 Custom Badass Distortion for a slew of amp-like gain structures that won't mask your tone. It features a 100Hz cut and boost control for tonal shaping and a Bump switch for a low and mid-range boost, allowing you to dial in a wide range of overdrive tones. Back to results MXR Custom Badass Modified O.D. Overdrive Modified Tube Screamer-style overdrive with 100Hz boost and dual voicing modes. The Custom Badass Modified O.D. takes the Tube Screamer circuit and adds features that players typically mod for. The 100Hz control boosts low-end frequencies that traditional TS circuits cut, addressing the main criticism of that classic design. Four controls: Overdrive sets gain, Output adjusts level, Tone shapes highs, 100Hz adds bass boost. The bump switch toggles between smooth overdrive and a more aggressive, modern voicing with additional midrange presence. The modifications address why players take TS pedals to amp techs: more bass, more gain options, and tighter bass response for modern playing. The circuit maintains the essential midrange character while expanding usability. True bypass switching. For players who love Tube Screamer tone but want more flexibility without modifying a vintage pedal, the Modified O.D. delivers those improvements stock.
